title: SM-09.19 - What happens to Email Reports when a survey is unpublished or archived
intent: This article answers: SM-09.19 - What happens to Email Reports when a survey is unpublished or archived
short_answer: Email Reports stop immediately if the survey is unpublished, archived, frozen or deleted.
important_conditions: Reports are only sent while the survey is published.
If reports stop unexpectedly, check the survey status and the Email Report configuration.
